exposure: history of LBP before and during pregnancy
effects of LPP on daily life (Oswestry disability index)
outcome: prevalence of lumbopelvic pain (LPP) after childbirth
desire to consult a healthcare professional
cohort: The study included 98 postnatal Japanese women within 1 year of childbirth.
finding: Two thirds of postnatal Japanese women experienced lumbopelvic pain (66%), but despite a low consultation rate (9%), more than half (56%) desired to consult a healthcare professional, especially those with higher disability scores.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point in time for each woman, sometime within 1 year after childbirth.
